sourceNotes: 实验性应用分身扩展至浏览器、编辑器、AI 客户端及影音应用，支持为每个分身单独配置代理
AI 用量支持连接远端 Magpie，并按可用性切换本机数据源
启动项新增运行详情与日志查看，便于排查后台项目
加强应用分身来源校验
区分远端 Magpie 的认证与钥匙串错误，提供对应提示

en: Expands experimental app cloning to browsers, editors, AI clients, and media apps, with a separate proxy setting for each clone. Proxy support depends on the app; authenticated proxies are not supported.
AI usage can connect to a remote Magpie service and select available local data sources.
Adds runtime details and log viewing for startup items to help troubleshoot background services.
Strengthens clone source validation, checks whether profile data is in use before updating or deleting a clone, and prevents concurrent builds from removing each other's files.
Distinguishes remote Magpie authentication errors from Keychain errors and shows the corresponding message.
